preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: The edges must form a valid tree with n vertices and n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: len(colored) == n and all(c in 'WN' for c in colored)
preconditions.description: The colored string must have length n and contain only 'W' or 'N' characters.
There must be at least one uncolored vertex in the colored string.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of 'White', 'Draw', or 'Black'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'White' if any(path_of_three_white(colored, edges) for path in paths) else (stdout == 'Draw' if all(colored) else stdout == 'Black')
postconditions.description: The output reflects the game result based on the colored vertices and edges.
